The ribbon's modeled fold shading conflicts with the product photograph's soft diffuse frontal light and with the declared perfectly even graphic illumination; the circuit idea (ribbon diving behind the waist, re-emerging at the shoulder) is legible, but the band's 3D rendering undercuts the flat-print concept that unifies palette, material and typography.
